lines.zh: 粉色的泥做的，走路有点晃。
lines.en: Pink clay. My walk wobbles.
Short steps. Keeping up with the line.

lines.zh: 染料渗进泥里，颜色很淡。
lines.en: Dye soaked into the clay. Pale.

lines.zh: 我不停地朝一个方向走。
lines.en: I keep walking one direction.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖是圆的，走起来笨。
lines.en: Round knees. Clumsy gait.
A little slower than the rest.

lines.zh: 身上的粉色被土盖住一半。
lines.en: Half my pink is covered in dirt.
I walk when they walk, stop when they stop.

lines.zh: 粉色染料一刷，我就变装。
lines.en: One coat of pink dye and I change colors.
Head low, close to the ground.
I don't watch the road. I watch the one ahead.
Each step sheds a little clay.

lines.zh: 我站着，颜色在灰里显眼。
lines.en: I stand. My color stands out in the grey.

lines.zh: 我手指上的泥已经干了。
lines.en: The clay on my fingers has dried.
Waiting to be called to fight.

lines.zh: 染料给了我颜色，没给我名字。
lines.en: Dye gave me color. Not a name.
I stand side-on. Steadier.

lines.zh: 身边有个同伴，也是泥的。
lines.en: A companion beside me. Clay too.
I lift a hand and shake it.

lines.zh: 这里的风把粉吹掉了一层。
lines.en: The wind blew off a layer of pink.

lines.zh: 粉染料渗进泥里，颜色很淡。
lines.en: The pink dye has soaked in pale.
I stare at a crack in the ground.
Taller than me. Looking up tires me.

lines.zh: 我的脸是泥的，看不出表情。
lines.en: Clay face. No expression to read.

lines.zh: 你手里没有武器，我不动。
lines.en: Empty hands. I hold still.

lines.zh: 你的视线落在我的颜色上。
lines.en: Your gaze landed on my color.

lines.zh: 我记下你站的第几块砖。
lines.en: I noted which tile you're on.
I won't swing first. Rest easy.
Come over and I'll block.
A few steps between us.

lines.zh: 我把身体正过来对着你。
lines.en: I turn square to you.
That expression. I don't understand it.

lines.zh: 我抬了一下手，又放下了。
lines.en: I half-raise a hand, then lower it.

lines.zh: 我身上有点碎屑掉下来。
lines.en: A little grit falls off me.

lines.zh: 我掉了一块泥，粉色的那一角。
lines.en: A chunk of clay fell off, the pink corner.
That set me crooked.
I fell back. Formation intact.
More cracks now.
I don't cry out. Clay doesn't.
Where you hit is hollow now.
I lift my arm. Still moves.
You scraped the color off me.

lines.zh: 同伴替我挡住了下一步。
lines.en: A companion took the next one.
I'll keep standing up.
Beetroot juice can't dye me any further.
Clay things don't eat.
Hold it up. I'll only look.

lines.zh: 这不是木棍，也不是皮革。
lines.en: That's not a stick. Not leather.

lines.zh: 我不会因为这个听你的。
lines.en: That won't make me obey.
That's not a weapon. Keep it.

lines.zh: 你为什么老是举着东西？
lines.en: Why do you keep holding things up?
Food gets no reaction from me.
Enemies get a reaction.
Drop it. We'll part ways.

lines.zh: 粉色染料一染，我就换装。
lines.en: One pink dye and I change coats.
Some clay came off. Light.

lines.zh: 别压着我，我比看起来脆。
lines.en: Don't lean on me. I'm more brittle than I look.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的肩，凹了一块。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder. A dent.
I go around. No retaliation.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，我歪了，又站直。
lines.en: I went crooked. Straightened.
Pink clay on you now.
Wedged. I give ground.
A muffled thud. Nothing more.
My foot is flattened; I'll patch it with clay.
I was shaped by hand.

lines.zh: 我只剩一把没烧透的泥。
lines.en: All I have left is a handful of half-baked clay.

lines.zh: 你可以再给我染一个颜色。
lines.en: You could dye me another color.
I don't follow you.
Any other pink ones among us?
Don't crush me; I'm not dry yet.
I need to hold formation.
Don't touch these clay hands.
Not my concern.
Standing is enough for me.
I pick it up. My hand trembles.
This could serve as a stick.
Pink dye? I have no use for it.
More fragments on the ground.
Weak grip. Clay hands.
Yours? The ground's cold.
I stow it at my waist.
A bit heavy. I hold it close.
Not mine. I keep it.
I'll hold it until someone asks.
My squad sees you.
My hand goes up and the line moves.
You're on the open ground ahead.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，整队就跟着动。
lines.en: I raise my hand and the squad moves.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在这一片很显眼。
lines.en: My color shows plainly here.
Locked on. To the end.
The others see you too.
This time, we don't yield.
You moved. Then it's begun.
My feet are planted.

lines.zh: 我把手里的东西换了个握法。
lines.en: I shift my grip on what I hold.
That open patch ahead. I'll take it.

lines.zh: 我数了，你们只有几个人。
lines.en: I counted. Few of you.
I won't stop until you're down.

lines.zh: 粉色的影子，挪到你脚边。
lines.en: A pink shadow shuffles up to your feet.
You retreat. We push forward.
I'm no runner. I'm a blocker.
You take the flank. I turn.
My line is ahead.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西挡不住一排人。
lines.en: That won't stop a row of us.
The cracks on me are spreading.

lines.zh: 你的位置已经给围住了。
lines.en: Your position is closed off.
No rush. The formation tightens.

lines.zh: 你听见脚步了吗？不止我的。
lines.en: Hear the steps? Not only mine.

lines.zh: 我们这一排，再挤近一格。
lines.en: This row advances one more block.
My shoulder's turned in.
Every clay hand is up. Now.
This hand of mine is up.
Don't retreat. Same either way.
I charge. Shoulder first.
Straightforward. No tricks.

lines.zh: 你退了，我的同伴跟上来。
lines.en: You stepped back. My companion steps up.

lines.zh: 我的拳头碰到你的护甲。
lines.en: My fist met your armor.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的手臂掉了一块。
lines.en: That cost my arm a chunk.

lines.zh: 你挡得住我，挡不住旁边的。
lines.en: You can block me. Not the one beside me.

lines.zh: 我抓着你的袖子，被甩开了。
lines.en: I gripped your sleeve. Thrown off.

lines.zh: 你把泥打散了，又聚起来。
lines.en: You scattered the clay. It gathered.
That was the formation working.
I step back. Let another take it.
That put you on one knee.
One more, light.
Clay breaks. The hand stays.
A layer of earth on you.
Several of us around you.
My fist rises. Slowly.

lines.zh: 我被染成粉色，放在地上。
lines.en: Dyed pink and set down.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，身边有几个同伴。
lines.en: I open my eyes. Companions nearby.

lines.zh: 颜料还没干，蹭到了地上。
lines.en: Paint still wet. It smeared.

lines.zh: 我先站直，然后看了看队形。
lines.en: I straighten, then check the formation.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在土里很扎眼。
lines.en: My color stands out in the dirt.
I flex my hands. Clay still soft.

lines.zh: 我站到队伍旁边的位置。
lines.en: I take my place beside the line.
Wind blows. Pink dust falls.

lines.zh: 粉色的我，落地只有一缕灰。
lines.en: Pink as I am, I land with only a puff of dust.

lines.zh: 这地方需要有人挡在前面。
lines.en: This place needs someone up front.
Fighting in the distance.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，踏出了第一步。
lines.en: I lift a foot and take the first step.
Fire turned the pink black.

lines.zh: 落下来，摔掉了一条胳膊。
lines.en: Landed. An arm broke off.
Soaked too long. I'm coming apart.

lines.zh: 气浪把我们这一排吹散了。
lines.en: The blast scattered our whole row.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进了我的肩膀。
lines.en: Something pierced my shoulder.
That light softened my clay.

lines.zh: 我在干裂，一块一块地掉。
lines.en: I'm drying out. Falling piece by piece.

lines.zh: 雷落在泥上，颜色烧掉了。
lines.en: Lightning struck. The color burned off.
Falling. I broke into pieces.
